name: Rakuo Kumode
source:
Computer science major at Tricone University. Wants to become a software engineer.

2nd gen Japanese immigrant. Has a turbulent (sometimes violent) relationship with his strict, affluent family.

Loves: Nelli
Likes: Nelli, games, caffeine
Hates: Animals, insects, touchy people (except Nelli)
